question: An assortment of 200 pencils is sold through a catalog for $\$19.90$. Shipping is an additional $\$6.95$. Including the charges for both the pencils and the shipping, what is the average cost, in cents, for each pencil? Express your answer rounded to the nearest whole number.

answer:
The total cost of the pencils and shipping is calculated by adding \$19.90 and \$6.95:
\[
19.90 + 6.95 = 26.85 \text{ dollars}
\]

Converting the total cost to cents:
\[
26.85 \text{ dollars} = 26.85 \times 100 = 2685 \text{ cents}
\]

Finding the average cost per pencil by dividing the total cost in cents by the number of pencils:
\[
\frac{2685 \text{ cents}}{200} = 13.425 \text{ cents per pencil}
\]

Rounding 13.425 to the nearest whole number gives:
\[
13.425 \approx 13
\]

Thus, the average cost per pencil is \(\boxed{13}\) cents.
